# Case: unrestrained_free_particle
import numpy as np
initial = np.array([[-1.15,0.4],[-0.35,-0.6],[0.6,0.2],[1.25,-0.3]])
bias = np.array([[0.7,-0.65,0.5,0.17,0.2],[1.1,0.55,0.65,0.11,1.1],[0.45,-0.1,0.8,0.23,2.2],[0.85,0.35,0.45,0.19,-0.7]])
cuts = np.array([-1.05,-0.45,0.15,0.8])
alpha=0.35; dt=0.025; friction=1.8; mass=1.3; thermal=1.0
barrier=2.4; tilt=0.25; width=0.4; htilt=0.18; lag=13
noise=np.random.default_rng(1847).standard_normal((4,3600))
noise=noise[:,:23]
barrier=0.;tilt=0.;bias[:,0]=0.
assert np.allclose(simulate_biased_paths(initial.copy(), bias.copy(), noise.copy(), dt, friction, mass, thermal, barrier, tilt), target)
